purpose: Iteratively improve an inspectable visual creation state inside a deterministic simulated world until no currently registered improvement rule can identify another change, while preserving every simulated cinematic frame and explicitly refusing to call that state perfect.

properties.thought: inspectable visual scene state with canvas and objects; objects may begin with incomplete Paintgun channels
properties.defaults: optional caller-visible channel defaults available to the simulator
properties.alternatives: optional per-object known alternative channel values available to improvement rules
properties.palette: optional known color candidates used for missing color and contrast improvement
properties.criteria: optional deterministic criteria such as minimum_contrast and fit_canvas
properties.max_iterations: optional explicit simulation bound from 1 to 32

contains: cinematic SVG frame per iteration when renderable

relationships: simulation happens before reality materialization rather than only testing after a draft is built
the stopping state NO_KNOWN_IMPROVEMENTS means no currently registered improvement rule can identify another change, not perfection
each simulation iteration preserves a cinematic projection of the exact state when the Paintgun grammar can render it
the final simulated thought can be consumed by AXM-CAP-PAINTGUN-SPECIALIST without reinterpreting its scene graph

anatomy_refs.basis: The simulated visual thought keeps shape, surface, color, light, shade and skin parameters as an inspectable compositional graph before rendering.
Simulation advances through explicit state transitions and terminates in a typed NO_KNOWN_IMPROVEMENTS or HOLD state.

limitations: v0 improvement rules cover structural Paintgun-channel completion, bounded parameter repair, known-shape canvas fit, and contrast improvement from supplied known alternatives or palette
NO_KNOWN_IMPROVEMENTS is not optimality, perfection, semantic correctness, or aesthetic proof
new evidence or a newly installed improvement rule may reopen a previously stopped simulation
the cinematic projection currently uses the bounded local SVG Paintgun grammar rather than a photoreal physical renderer

truth.basis: The stop condition says only that currently registered rules see no further improvement; all known gaps, iterations, frames and limitations remain visible.

agency.basis: Callers may provide open visual intent, defaults, alternatives and criteria without the simulator silently replacing the requested creation direction.

continuity.basis: Simulation changes only an in-memory candidate state; reality is touched only by the separate explicit materialization capability.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Known improvements are explored before materialization and the final thought remains digest-bound to the cinematic state that was actually simulated.
